text: One Dark Pro 是面向 DSH Web 的暗色主题插件。它通过 DSH ThemeRuntime 注册主题，并在设置的通用设置区域加入开关。启用后将界面语义色彩 token 覆盖为 One Dark Pro 配色，同时把基础主题设为深色；关闭时恢复此前的主题偏好。插件还会将开关状态保存在浏览器 localStorage，并同步其他标签页。适合希望为 DSH Web 使用 VSCode 风格暗色配色的用户，不需要额外账号或 API 配置。

One Dark Pro adds a dark palette to DSH Web. It registers a theme and a toggle in General settings. Enabling it applies One Dark Pro colors; disabling it restores the previous theme preference. The choice is saved in localStorage and synchronized across tabs. No account or API setup is needed.
想把 DSH Web 换成 One Dark 风格的暗色界面。
DSH 网页端有没有类似 VSCode 的深色配色？
让 DSH 的设置、按钮和侧边栏统一使用暗色主题。
我想从通用设置里一键切换网页主题。
Can I give the DSH web interface a VS Code style dark palette?
I want a toggle to switch my DSH web theme on and off.
Keep the dark theme choice saved between browser visits.
One Dark Pro 提供「全局暗色配色」功能：注册并覆盖 DSH 的界面语义颜色 token。启用开关后应用深色基础主题与 One Dark Pro 色板，涵盖背景、文字、按钮和状态颜色。
One Dark Pro 提供「设置页主题开关」功能：在设置的通用设置项中显示开关。点击后启用或关闭色板，并在关闭时恢复此前主题偏好。
One Dark Pro 提供「保存与跨标签同步偏好」功能：将是否启用及此前主题偏好写入浏览器 localStorage，并监听 storage 事件同步其他标签页。
希望网页端主题开关能记住我的选择，并在多个标签页保持一致。

one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin README · one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin：One Dark Pro theme for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.

Install this plugin to add a "One Dark Pro" toggle in **Settings → General**. When enabled, the entire DSH Web interface switches to the classic VSCode One Dark Pro dark palette.

> [中文 README](./README.zh-CN.md)

one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin README · Features：- Registers a third-party `one-dark-pro` theme id via the official `ctx.theme` service
- Toggle in Settings → General
- Switches the base preference to dark and stacks a One Dark Pro token override layer
- Persists the choice in browser `localStorage`
- Remembers and restores your previous light/dark/system preference when disabled
- Cross-tab sync

one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin README · Method A: Install from tarball (recommended)：Build the plugin (see Development), then pack and install it into the `web` profile:

```sh
cd one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
```

Verify the layer is present without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Then restart `dsh web` and open the Web UI.

```sh

one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin README · After creating the junction in packages/client/one-dark-pro-dsh-plugin：cd deepseek-harness
pnpm run build:lib:client
```

The build emits:

- `lib/index.js` — host half
- `lib/invariant.js` — shared invariants
- `lib/client.js` — browser bundle
- `lib/types/` — TypeScript declarations

- 关闭时自动恢复之前的浅色/深色/跟随系统偏好
